description: Authored dev mods that are git-tracked here (so a clean build cannot erase them) and copied into <install>/mods on every build by devtools/build-headless.ps1. Each entry's source lives at dev-mods/<path>/. Per-mod 'dev' and 'release' flags control default inclusion; override at build time with -DevMods all|none|<comma-list>, or at release time with the release script's mod flags.

mods.summary: Halo-Needler-style custom weapon: tracking primary needles, non-tracking explosive secondary with small pink contact explosions.

Maian crystal pistol test weapon: textured held model, six crystals that are its magazine (fired one at a time, regrow in their sockets), sticky crystal projectile. Include with -DevMods crystal_pistol.

Blank Room: a small original level (one room, four pillars, eight player starts) that holds nothing of the original game. The template Forge starts a shareable level from. Built by dev-mods/blank_room/build_blank_room.py. Include with -DevMods blank_room.

Model Room: an original level made from a model (model_room.glb, written by dev-mods/model_room/make_model_room.py) by tools/build_level_from_model.py: two platforms on ramps, pillars, cover, eight starts. Forge step F5's example. Include with -DevMods model_room.
